tha-ap169:1.1: Yūthikapupphiya.] Candabhāgānadītīre anusotaṃ vajām' ahaṃ / sayambhum addasaṃ tattha sālarājaṃ va pupphitaṃ. // //
tha-ap169:2.1: Pupphaṃ yūthikam ādāya upagacchiṃ mahāmuniṃ / pasannacitto sumano Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap169:3.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ // //
tha-ap169:4.1: Sattasaṭṭhi ito kappe eko Samuddharo ahu / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap169:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ ā. Yūthikapupphiyo thero i. g. ā-ti. Yūthikapupphiyattherassa
